// Volatility-Compression Release Coil Model
// ATR/range coil + normalized vol-of-vol + efficiency predictability + release fire

atrLen = input(14, "ATR Length", 2, 60, 1)
coilLen = input(50, "Coil Length", 10, 150, 1)
vvLen = input(20, "VoV Length", 5, 60, 1)
effLen = input(20, "Efficiency Length", 5, 60, 1)
releaseMult = input(1.5, "Release Mult", 1.1, 3.0, 0.1)
loadThresh = input(80, "Load Threshold", 50, 95, 1)
vvRiseThresh = input(0.0, "VoV Rise Threshold", 0.0, 0.001, 0.00005)
predThresh = input(0.5, "Predictability Threshold", 0.1, 0.9, 0.05)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

tr = max(high - low, abs(high - close[1]), abs(low - close[1]))
atrVal = atr(high, low, close, atrLen)
currRange = high - low
rangeRatio = currRange / max(atrVal, 0.000000001)
coilBase = highest(atrVal, coilLen)
coilLoad = 100 * (1 - atrVal / max(coilBase, 0.000000001))
atrChg = atrVal - atrVal[1]
vovRaw = stdev(atrChg, vvLen)
vov = vovRaw / max(atrVal, 0.000000001)
vovRising = vov - vov[1] > vvRiseThresh and vov > vov[vvLen]
sumR = sma(currRange, effLen) * effLen
eff = abs(close - close[effLen]) / max(sumR, 0.000000001)
midBar = (high + low) / 2
releaseRange = currRange > releaseMult * atrVal[1]
loaded = coilLoad >= loadThresh and vovRising
loadedPred = loaded and eff >= predThresh
loadedUnpred = loaded and eff < predThresh
buyCond = loaded and releaseRange and close > midBar
sellCond = loaded and releaseRange and close < midBar
buySig = buyCond and not buyCond[1]
sellSig = sellCond and not sellCond[1]
buyPred = buySig and eff >= predThresh
buyUnpred = buySig and eff < predThresh
sellPred = sellSig and eff >= predThresh
sellUnpred = sellSig and eff < predThresh
loadLvl = loadThresh + (close - close[1]) * 0.001
predLvl = predThresh + (close - close[1]) * 0.00001
predScaled = eff * 100 + (close - close[1]) * 0.001
vovScaled = vov * 5000 + coilLoad * 0.05

if buyPred { plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy Pred Release", "triangleup", "#00ff88") }
if buyUnpred { plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy Unpred Release", "triangleup", "#ffd43b") }
if sellPred { plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell Pred Release", "triangledown", "#ff4477") }
if sellUnpred { plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell Unpred Release", "triangledown", "#ffaa00") }
if buySig { plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy Release", "coneup", "#00e5ff", 1.0 * markerSize, 1, "separate") }
if sellSig { plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell Release", "conedown", "#ff33cc", 1.0 * markerSize, 1, "separate") }
if loadedUnpred and not releaseRange and not buySig and not sellSig { plotshape_3d(bar_index, close, "Loaded Unpred", "diamond", "#ffd43b", 0.6 * markerSize, 2, "separate") }
if loadedPred and not releaseRange and not buySig and not sellSig { plotshape_3d(bar_index, close, "Loaded Pred", "sphere", "#00ff88", 0.6 * markerSize, 2, "separate") }
if buyPred { label3d(bar_index, low, "Predictable-Release", "#00e5ff", 1.0, 1, "separate") }
if sellPred { label3d(bar_index, high, "Predictable-Release", "#ff33cc", 1.0, 1, "separate") }
if buyUnpred { label3d(bar_index, low, "Unpredictable-Release", "#ffd43b", 1.0, 2, "separate") }
if sellUnpred { label3d(bar_index, high, "Unpredictable-Release", "#ffd43b", 1.0, 2, "separate") }

bgcolor(buySig or sellSig ? "#ff44cc" : loaded ? "#3b2f00" : "#0a1628")
plot(coilLoad, "Coil Load", "#22aaff", 2, "separate")
plot(loadLvl, "Load Threshold", "#ffd43b", 1, "separate")
plot(eff, "Predictability", "#00ff88", 2, "separate")
plot(predLvl, "Pred Threshold", "#ff4477", 1, "separate")
plot3d(coilLoad, "Coil Load 3D", "ribbon", "#22aaff", "separate", 0)
plot3d(predScaled, "Predictability Trail", "trail", "#00ff88", "separate", 1)
plot3d(vovScaled, "VoV Scatter", "scatter", "#b48cff", "separate", 2)

sessStart = input(0, "Session Start Hour", 0, 23, 1)
sessLen = input(8, "Session Length Hours", 1, 24, 1)
structLB = input(2, "Structure Lookback", 1, 20, 1)
confLen = input(10, "Confidence Length", 1, 50, 1)
bufTicks = input(2, "Hard Stop Buffer Ticks", 0, 20, 1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

barsPerHour = 12
cycleLen = sessLen * barsPerHour
offsetBars = sessStart * barsPerHour
relBar = bar_index - offsetBars
cyclePos = relBar % cycleLen
newSession = cyclePos == 0

var sh = 0.0
var sl = 0.0
var inPos = 0

shPrev = sh[1]
slPrev = sl[1]

sessHigh = newSession ? high : max(shPrev, high)
sessLow = newSession ? low : min(slPrev, low)

sh := sessHigh
sl := sessLow

hClose = security("1h", close)
hHighSrc = security("1h", high)
hLowSrc = security("1h", low)
hHighLag = hHighSrc[1]
hLowLag = hLowSrc[1]
hClosePrev = hClose[1]

hHiPrev = highest(hHighLag, structLB)
hLoPrev = lowest(hLowLag, structLB)
htfRange = hHiPrev - hLoPrev
rangeOk = htfRange > 0

hBullBreak = rangeOk and hClose > hHiPrev
hBearBreak = rangeOk and hClose < hLoPrev

bullQRaw = rangeOk ? (hClose - hLoPrev) / htfRange : 0
bearQRaw = rangeOk ? (hHiPrev - hClose) / htfRange : 0
bullQ = max(0, min(1, bullQRaw))
bearQ = max(0, min(1, bearQRaw))
activeQ = hBullBreak ? bullQ : hBearBreak ? bearQ : 0
avgQ = sma(activeQ, confLen)
conf01 = 0.5 + 0.5 * avgQ

tickEst = close * 0.0001
bufferPx = bufTicks * tickEst
longStop = sessLow - bufferPx
shortStop = sessHigh + bufferPx
activeStop = inPos == 1 ? longStop : inPos == -1 ? shortStop : close

sessHighPrev = shPrev
sessLowPrev = slPrev
buyBreak = crossover(close, sessHighPrev)
sellBreak = crossunder(close, sessLowPrev)
bullEdge = hBullBreak and not hBullBreak[1]
bearEdge = hBearBreak and not hBearBreak[1]

buySig = buyBreak and hBullBreak
sellSig = sellBreak and hBearBreak
exitLongSig = crossunder(close, sessHighPrev) or bearEdge
exitShortSig = crossover(close, sessLowPrev) or bullEdge

if buySig {
    model.confidence(conf01)
    model.stopLoss(longStop, "abs")
    model.longEntry("siege")
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
    model.confidence(conf01)
    model.stopLoss(shortStop, "abs")
    model.shortEntry("siege")
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if exitLongSig {
    model.longExit("siege")
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "ExitL", "diamond", "#ffcc00")
}
if exitShortSig {
    model.shortExit("siege")
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "ExitS", "diamond", "#ffcc00")
}

if buySig {
    inPos := 1
}
if sellSig {
    inPos := -1
}
if exitLongSig {
    inPos := 0
}
if exitShortSig {
    inPos := 0
}

plot(sessHigh, "Session High", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
plot(sessLow, "Session Low", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")
plot(activeStop, "Hard Stop", "#ffcc00", 1, "stepline")

volLen = input(14, "Volatility Length", 5, 30, 1)
momLen = input(12, "Momentum Length", 5, 30, 1)
breakLen = input(20, "Breakout Length", 10, 50, 1)
volMult = input(1.5, "Volatility Multiplier", 0.5, 3.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

vol = stdev(close, volLen)
mom = close - close[momLen]
hh = highest(high, breakLen)
ll = lowest(low, breakLen)
upperBreak = hh + volMult * vol
lowerBreak = ll - volMult * vol

buySig = crossover(close, upperBreak) and mom > 0
sellSig = crossunder(close, lowerBreak) and mom < 0

if buySig {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if buySig {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 0, "3d")
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", "#ff4477", markerSize, 0, "3d")
}
plot(upperBreak, "Upper Breakout", "#ff4477", 1)
plot(lowerBreak, "Lower Breakout", "#22cc88", 1)
plot(mom, "Momentum", "#33aaff", 1, "separate")
hline(0, "#888888", "separate")
plot3d(upperBreak, "Upper 3D", "line3d", "#ff4477", "separate", 0)
plot3d(lowerBreak, "Lower 3D", "line3d", "#22cc88", "separate", 1)

lookback = input(80, "Lookback Length", 10, 300, 1)
f236 = input(0.236, "Fib 23.6% Level", 0.05, 0.95, 0.001)
f382 = input(0.382, "Fib 38.2% Level", 0.05, 0.95, 0.001)
f50 = input(0.5, "Fib 50.0% Level", 0.05, 0.95, 0.001)
f618 = input(0.618, "Fib 61.8% Level", 0.05, 0.95, 0.001)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

swingHigh = highest(high, lookback)
swingLow = lowest(low, lookback)
rng = swingHigh - swingLow

fib236 = swingHigh - rng * f236
fib382 = swingHigh - rng * f382
fib50 = swingHigh - rng * f50
fib618 = swingHigh - rng * f618

buySig = crossover(close, fib618)
sellSig = crossunder(close, fib382)

if barstate.isconfirmed and buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Reclaim 61.8%", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Reclaim 61.8%", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 3, "3d")
    label.new(bar_index, low, "Reclaim 61.8%", "#22cc88", 1, true, "center", "fibEvt")
}
if barstate.isconfirmed and sellSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Lost 38.2%", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Lost 38.2%", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 1, "3d")
    label.new(bar_index, high, "Lost 38.2%", "#ff4477", 1, true, "center", "fibEvt")
}

plot(fib236, "23.6%", "#00ccff", 1, "stepline")
plot(fib382, "38.2%", "#ffcc00", 1, "stepline")
plot(fib50, "50%", "#b48cff", 1, "stepline")
plot(fib618, "61.8%", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")

plot3d(fib236, "Fib 23.6%", "line3d", "#00ccff", "3d", 0)
plot3d(fib382, "Fib 38.2%", "line3d", "#ffcc00", "3d", 1)
plot3d(fib50, "Fib 50%", "line3d", "#b48cff", "3d", 2)
plot3d(fib618, "Fib 61.8%", "line3d", "#22cc88", "3d", 3)

fastLen = input(10, "Fast Len", 5, 30, 1)
medLen = input(30, "Med Len", 15, 60, 1)
slowLen = input(60, "Slow Len", 30, 120, 1)
skewLen = input(60, "Skew Len", 20, 120, 1)
compressLookback = input(50, "Compression Lookback", 20, 100, 1)
expansionPct = input(15.0, "Expansion %", 5.0, 50.0, 0.5)
skewBullLevel = input(0.2, "Skew Bull Level", 0.0, 0.8, 0.05)
skewBearLevel = input(-0.2, "Skew Bear Level", -0.8, 0.0, 0.05)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

ret = (close - close[1]) / (close[1] + 0.0000001)
fastVol = stdev(ret, fastLen) * sqrt(fastLen) * 100
medVol = stdev(ret, medLen) * sqrt(medLen) * 100
slowVol = stdev(ret, slowLen) * sqrt(slowLen) * 100
hi = highest(high, skewLen)
lo = lowest(low, skewLen)
skew = (close - lo) / (hi - lo + 0.0000001) * 2 - 1
spread = fastVol - slowVol
slopeMid = medVol - slowVol
compLow = lowest(fastVol, compressLookback)
warm = bar_index > slowLen
compression = warm and fastVol <= compLow and fastVol < medVol and fastVol < slowVol
expansionImpulse = warm and fastVol > fastVol[1] * (1 + expansionPct / 100)
impulseVol = expansionImpulse and 1 or 0
impulseLayer = impulseVol * fastVol

var barsSinceComp = 1000.0
var compSkew = 0.0
var fired = 0.0

if compression {
    barsSinceComp := 0
    compSkew := skew
    fired := 0
} else {
    barsSinceComp := barsSinceComp[1] + 1
}

expansion = expansionImpulse and barsSinceComp <= 5
bullFlip = skew[1] <= skewBullLevel and skew > skewBullLevel and compSkew < skewBearLevel
bearFlip = skew[1] >= skewBearLevel and skew < skewBearLevel and compSkew > skewBullLevel
buySig = expansion and bullFlip and fired[1] == 0
sellSig = expansion and bearFlip and fired[1] == 0

if buySig {
    fired := 1
}

if sellSig {
    fired := 1
}

if buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, fastVol, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", 1.0 * markerSize, 3, "separate")
}

if sellSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, fastVol, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", 1.0 * markerSize, 3, "separate")
}

plot(spread, "Spread fast-slow", "#33ccff", 1, "separate")
plot(skew, "Skew", "#ffcc33", 1, "separate")
hline(0, "#888888", "separate")
hline(0.2, "#22cc88", "separate")
hline(-0.2, "#ff4477", "separate")
plot3d(fastVol, "Term Surface", "manifold", "#33ccff", "separate", 0)
plot3d(medVol, "Spine", "ribbon", "#ffcc33", "separate", 1)
plot3d(impulseLayer, "Impulse", "bars3d", "#ff4477", "separate", 2)

ch1in = input(20, "Ch1 dBm", 0, 100, 1)
ch2in = input(40, "Ch2 dBm", 0, 100, 1)
ch3in = input(60, "Ch3 dBm", 0, 100, 1)
ch4in = input(80, "Ch4 dBm", 0, 100, 1)
ch5in = input(100, "Ch5 dBm", 0, 100, 1)
baseThickness = input(1.0, "Base Thickness", 0.5, 5.0, 0.1)
maxBoost = input(4.0, "Max Thickness Boost", 0.0, 8.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

rangeDen = high - low + 0.001
dyn0 = (close - open) / rangeDen * 12
cyc = bar_index % 100
sweep = cyc * 0.5 - 25
cyc2 = bar_index % 20
tilt = (cyc2 - 9.5) * 3

c1raw = ch1in + dyn0 + sweep + tilt
c2raw = ch2in + dyn0 + sweep + tilt * 0.5
c3raw = ch3in + dyn0 + sweep
c4raw = ch4in + dyn0 + sweep - tilt * 0.5
c5raw = ch5in + dyn0 + sweep - tilt

c1t = max(c1raw, 0)
c1 = min(c1t, 100)
c2t = max(c2raw, 0)
c2 = min(c2t, 100)
c3t = max(c3raw, 0)
c3 = min(c3t, 100)
c4t = max(c4raw, 0)
c4 = min(c4t, 100)
c5t = max(c5raw, 0)
c5 = min(c5t, 100)

arrayAvg = (c1 + c2 + c3 + c4 + c5) / 5
curveThickness = baseThickness + (arrayAvg / 100) * maxBoost
splineLvl = arrayAvg
scaleFactor = 1.0
h1 = c1 * scaleFactor
h2 = c2 * scaleFactor
h3 = c3 * scaleFactor
h4 = c4 * scaleFactor
h5 = c5 * scaleFactor

ascOrder = c5 > c4 and c4 > c3
descOrder = c5 < c4 and c4 < c3
crossUp60 = arrayAvg > 60 and arrayAvg[1] <= 60
crossDn40 = arrayAvg < 40 and arrayAvg[1] >= 40
buySig = crossUp60 and ascOrder
sellSig = crossDn40 and descOrder
allHigh = c1 > 80 and c2 > 80 and c3 > 80 and c4 > 80 and c5 > 80
allLow = c1 < 20 and c2 < 20 and c3 < 20 and c4 < 20 and c5 < 20
alertCond = arrayAvg > 85 or allHigh or allLow
alertSig = alertCond and not alertCond[1]

if buySig {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 5, "separate")
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 5, "separate")
}
if alertSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Alert", "diamond", "#ffcc33")
  label3d(bar_index, arrayAvg, "Alert", "#ffcc33", 1, 6, "separate")
}
bgcolor(arrayAvg > 85, "#22cc8822", "separate")
bgcolor(arrayAvg < 40, "#ff447722", "separate")

plot(c1, "Ch1", "#33aaff", 1, "separate")
plot(c2, "Ch2", "#33ccff", 1, "separate")
plot(c3, "Ch3", "#33ffcc", 1, "separate")
plot(c4, "Ch4", "#ccaa33", 1, "separate")
plot(c5, "Ch5", "#ff8833", 1, "separate")
plot(arrayAvg, "Array Avg", "#ffcc33", 2, "separate")
plot(splineLvl, "Spline Twin", "#22cc88", curveThickness, "separate")
plot3d(h1, "Cyl1", "bars3d", "#33aaff", "separate", 0)
plot3d(h2, "Cyl2", "bars3d", "#33ccff", "separate", 1)
plot3d(h3, "Cyl3", "bars3d", "#33ffcc", "separate", 2)
plot3d(h4, "Cyl4", "bars3d", "#ccaa33", "separate", 3)
plot3d(h5, "Cyl5", "bars3d", "#ff8833", "separate", 4)
plot3d(splineLvl, "Spline", "ribbon", "#22cc88", "separate", 5)

dirX = input(1.0, "Wind Dir X", -5.0, 5.0, 0.1)
dirY = input(0.0, "Wind Dir Y", -5.0, 5.0, 0.1)
dirZ = input(0.0, "Wind Dir Z", -5.0, 5.0, 0.1)
wind_speed_knots = input(10.0, "Wind Speed Knots", 0.0, 100.0, 0.5)
min_speed_knots = input(0.0, "Min Speed Knots", 0.0, 50.0, 0.5)
max_speed_knots = input(50.0, "Max Speed Knots", 5.0, 100.0, 1.0)
base_tail_length = input(1.0, "Base Tail Length", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)
length_per_knot = input(0.1, "Length Per Knot", 0.01, 0.5, 0.01)
high_wind_alert_knots = input(30.0, "High Wind Alert Knots", 5.0, 100.0, 1.0)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

wob = ((bar_index % 40) - 20) / 200.0
priceMod = (close - open) / (close + 0.000000001) * 2.0
rangeMod = (high - low) / (close + 0.000000001) * 1.5

wx = dirX + wob + priceMod * 0.1
wy = dirY + wob * 0.5 + rangeMod * 0.1
wz = dirZ + wob * 0.25 + priceMod * 0.05

windSpeed = wind_speed_knots + priceMod * 2.0 + wob * 4.0

mag = sqrt(wx * wx + wy * wy + wz * wz)
safeMag = mag + 0.000000001
nx = wx / safeMag
ny = wy / safeMag
nz = wz / safeMag

horiz = sqrt(wx * wx + wy * wy)
safeHoriz = horiz + 0.000000001

axYaw = abs(wx)
ayYaw = abs(wy)
maxYaw = axYaw >= ayYaw ? axYaw : ayYaw
minYaw = axYaw >= ayYaw ? ayYaw : axYaw
tYaw = minYaw / (maxYaw + 0.000000001)
aYawSmall = tYaw / (1.0 + 0.28 * tYaw * tYaw)
yawAbsRad = axYaw >= ayYaw ? aYawSmall : 1.5707963 - aYawSmall
yawRad = yawAbsRad
if wx < 0.0 {
    yawRad = 3.14159265 - yawAbsRad
}
if wx < 0.0 and wy < 0.0 {
    yawRad = -3.14159265 + yawAbsRad
}
if wx >= 0.0 and wy < 0.0 {
    yawRad = 0.0 - yawAbsRad
}

azPitch = abs(wz)
axPitch = safeHoriz
maxPitch = axPitch >= azPitch ? axPitch : azPitch
minPitch = axPitch >= azPitch ? azPitch : axPitch
tPitch = minPitch / (maxPitch + 0.000000001)
aPitchSmall = tPitch / (1.0 + 0.28 * tPitch * tPitch)
pitchAbsRad = axPitch >= azPitch ? aPitchSmall : 1.5707963 - aPitchSmall
pitchRad = pitchAbsRad
if wz < 0.0 {
    pitchRad = 0.0 - pitchAbsRad
}
rollRad = 0.0

yawDeg = yawRad * 57.29578
pitchDeg = pitchRad * 57.29578
rollDeg = 0.0

tail_length = base_tail_length + windSpeed * length_per_knot

span = max_speed_knots - min_speed_knots + 0.000000001
rawRatio = (windSpeed - min_speed_knots) / span
speed_ratio = rawRatio < 0.0 ? 0.0 : rawRatio > 1.0 ? 1.0 : rawRatio

windCol = speed_ratio < 0.25 ? "#2266ff" : speed_ratio < 0.5 ? "#22ccff" : speed_ratio < 0.75 ? "#ffaa22" : "#ff5511"
tailPlot = tail_length + wob * 0.2
yawPlot = yawDeg + wob

calmLevel = min_speed_knots + 2.0
highSig = crossover(windSpeed, high_wind_alert_knots)
calmSig = crossunder(windSpeed, calmLevel)
yawChange = abs(yawDeg - yawDeg[1])
pitchChange = abs(pitchDeg - pitchDeg[1])
shiftSig = yawChange > 30.0 or pitchChange > 30.0

if highSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "HighWind", "triangledown", "#ff5511")
}
if calmSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Calm", "triangleup", "#2266ff")
}
if shiftSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, close, "Shift", "diamond", "#ffcc00")
}

if highSig {
    model.entry("long", "HighWind")
}
if calmSig {
    model.exit("HighWind")
}

if bar_index == 0 {
    plotshape_3d(0, 0, "Origin", "sphere", "#ffffff", 0.5 * markerSize, 2, "separate", 0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
}

if highSig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "HighWind", "coneup", "#ff5511", tail_length * markerSize, 0, "separate", pitchDeg, yawDeg, rollDeg)
}
if calmSig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Calm", "conedown", "#2266ff", tail_length * markerSize, 1, "separate", pitchDeg, yawDeg, rollDeg)
}
if shiftSig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, close, "Shift", "diamond", windCol, tail_length * markerSize, 0, "separate", pitchDeg, yawDeg, rollDeg)
}
if highSig {
    label3d(bar_index, high, "HIGH WIND", "#ff5511", 1, 0, "separate")
}

plot(windSpeed, "Wind Speed Knots", "#ff8811", 2, "separate")
plot(tail_length, "Tail Length", "#2266ff", 1, "separate")
plot(yawDeg, "Yaw Deg", "#22ccff", 1, "separate")
plot3d(windSpeed, "Wind Speed", "ribbon", "#ff8811", "separate")
plot3d(tailPlot, "Tail Length", "line3d", "#2266ff", "separate", 1)

flowBase = input(100, "Flow PSI Base", 0, 300, 1)
critThresh = input(150, "Critical Threshold", 50, 300, 1)
rotationFactor = input(1.0, "Rotation Factor", 0.1, 5.0, 0.1)
ringCountIn = input(5, "Ring Count", 1, 10, 1)
ringExpSpeed = input(2.0, "Ring Expansion Speed", 0.1, 10.0, 0.1)
ringMaxR = input(10.0, "Ring Max Radius", 2.0, 30.0, 0.5)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

rangeHL = high - low
flow_psi = flowBase * 0.5 + close * 0.8 + rangeHL * 2.0
angVel = flow_psi * rotationFactor
overState = flow_psi > critThresh
ringOffset = ringMaxR / ringCountIn

var discAngle = 0.0
var lockFlag = 0.0
var phaseAcc = 0.0

overSig = overState and not overState[1]
resetSig = not overState and overState[1]

if not overState {
  discAngle := discAngle[1] + angVel
} else {
  discAngle := discAngle[1]
}
while discAngle > 360.0 {
  discAngle := discAngle - 360.0
}
if overState {
  lockFlag := 1.0
} else {
  lockFlag := 0.0
}
phaseAcc := phaseAcc[1] + ringExpSpeed
while phaseAcc > ringMaxR {
  phaseAcc := phaseAcc - ringMaxR
}
discRy = discAngle
rawPhase = phaseAcc
shockBase = rawPhase + 2.0 + ringOffset
shockVal = overState ? shockBase : 0.0
discVal = flow_psi
barPulse = (close - open) + (high - low) * 0.5
threshLine = critThresh + barPulse * 0.2

if overSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "OVERPRESSURE", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "OVER", "conedown", "#ff4477", 1.5 * markerSize, 1, "separate", 0, discRy, 0)
  label3d(bar_index, high, "OVERPRESSURE", "#ff4477", 2, 2, "separate")
  model.shortEntry("OverP")
}
if resetSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Reset", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Reset", "coneup", "#22cc88", 1.5 * markerSize, 1, "separate", 0, discRy, 0)
  model.exit("OverP")
}

plot(flow_psi, "Flow PSI", "#33aaff", 2, "separate", "separate")
plot(shockVal, "Shockwave Radius", "#ff4477", 1, "separate", "separate")
plot(threshLine, "Critical", "#ffcc00", 1, "stepline", "separate")
plot3d(discVal, "Valve Disc", "torus", "#33aaff", "separate", 0)
plot3d(shockVal, "Shockwave Rings", "vortex", "#ff4477", "separate", 1)
